champion.ezreal.name: Ezreal
champion.samira.name: Samira
champion.ezreal.title: the Prodigal Explorer
champion.ezreal.Q.desc: Fires a bolt that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit and applies on-hit effects. A hit lowers all his cooldowns by 1.5s.
champion.ezreal.W.desc: Fires an orb that marks the first enemy hit for 4s. Hitting it with an attack or ability detonates the mark for magic damage; detonating it with an ability restores 60 mana plus that ability's cost.
champion.ezreal.E.desc: Blinks up to 475 units, then fires a bolt at the nearest enemy (a marked one first) that deals magic damage.
champion.ezreal.R.desc: Fires a huge wave across the map that hits every enemy in its path for magic damage (50% against non-epic monsters).
champion.samira.title: the Desert Rose
champion.samira.Q.desc: Fires a shot that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit. With an enemy close in front, she slashes in an arc instead. Can critically strike for 125% damage.
champion.samira.W.desc: Spins her blade for 0.75s, slashing nearby enemies at the start and at the end for physical damage and destroying enemy missiles.
champion.samira.E.desc: Dashes 600 units, dealing magic damage to the enemies she passes through, then gains Attack Speed for 5s.
champion.samira.R.desc: Needs Style S. Fires 10 volleys over 2s at every enemy within 600 units for physical damage (25% against minions); each shot can critically strike. She is 30% slower meanwhile.
end.runes: rune points · {kills} kills to the next point

item.3004.passive: Awe: gain bonus AD equal to 2.5% of max Mana.
item.3026.passive: Rebirth: on taking lethal damage, revive with 50% base Health (once every 5 min).
item.3057.passive: Spellblade: after using an ability, your next attack deals +100% base AD.
item.3068.passive: Immolate: burns nearby enemies for magic damage per second (scales with level and bonus Health).
item.3071.passive: Carve: physical damage reduces the target's Armor by 6% (stacks 5x).
item.3078.passive: Spellblade: after using an ability, your next attack deals +200% base AD.
item.3085.passive: Wind's Fury: attacks fire bolts at up to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 55% damage and applying on-hit effects.
item.3110.passive: Winter's Caress: nearby enemies attack 20% slower.
item.3153.passive: Mist's Edge: attacks deal 6% of the target's current Health as physical damage.
item.3508.passive: Spellblade: your next attack after an ability deals +100% base AD +40% bonus AD and restores mana.
item.6672.passive: Bring It Down: every 3rd attack deals bonus physical damage (more against wounded targets).

rune.absolute-focus.desc: Above 70% Health, grants adaptive AD (up to 10 at level 18).
rune.absolute-focus.name: Absolute Focus
rune.absorb-life.desc: Kills heal 1% max Health (0.5s internal cooldown).
rune.absorb-life.name: Absorb Life
rune.aftershock.desc: When stunned, gain +35 Armor for 2.5s, then explode, dealing area damage. 20s cooldown.
rune.aftershock.name: Aftershock
rune.approach-velocity.desc: +7.5% Move Speed when moving toward a slowed enemy or your focus target.
rune.approach-velocity.name: Approach Velocity
rune.arcane-comet.desc: Hitting an ability launches a comet at the target, dealing area damage. 8s cooldown, reduced by ability hits.
rune.arcane-comet.name: Arcane Comet
rune.axiom-arcanist.name: Axiom Arcanist
rune.biscuit-delivery.desc: Every 2 min until 6 min, restores 8% of missing Health and Mana and grants +10 max Mana.
rune.biscuit-delivery.name: Biscuit Delivery
rune.bone-plating.desc: When taking damage, the next 3 hits within 1.5s deal 30–60 less. 55s cooldown.
rune.bone-plating.name: Bone Plating
rune.cash-back.name: Cash Back
rune.celerity.desc: +1% Move Speed; Move Speed bonuses are 7% stronger.
rune.celerity.name: Celerity
rune.cheap-shot.desc: Bonus true damage to slowed enemies, elite and epic monsters. 4s cooldown.
rune.cheap-shot.name: Cheap Shot
rune.conditioning.desc: After 5 min into the run: +8 Armor and +3% Armor.
rune.conditioning.name: Conditioning
rune.conqueror.desc: Hits stack AD (up to 12 stacks). At max stacks, 0.08% of damage dealt heals you.
rune.conqueror.name: Conqueror
rune.cosmic-insight.name: Cosmic Insight
rune.coup-de-grace.name: Coup de Grace
rune.cut-down.desc: +8% damage to elite and epic monsters.
rune.cut-down.name: Cut Down
rune.dark-harvest.desc: Hitting an enemy below 50% Health deals bonus damage that grows with Souls (+1 per 50 kills). 1.5s cooldown.
rune.dark-harvest.name: Dark Harvest
rune.deep-ward.desc: +6% damage to enemies more than 500 units away.
rune.deep-ward.name: Deep Ward
rune.demolish.desc: Your first hit on an epic every 45s deals +10% damage.
rune.demolish.name: Demolish
rune.electrocute.desc: 3 separate hits (attack or ability) on the same target within 3s deal bonus adaptive damage. 4s cooldown.
rune.electrocute.name: Electrocute
rune.first-strike.desc: Dealing the first damage to an elite or epic grants +7% damage against it for 3s.
rune.first-strike.name: First Strike
rune.fleet-footwork.desc: Attacks build Energy; at 100, your next attack heals 10 + 30% bonus AD and grants +20% Move Speed for 1s.
rune.fleet-footwork.name: Fleet Footwork
rune.font-of-life.desc: Hitting an elite or epic with an ability heals 1% of your max Health, once every 2s.
rune.font-of-life.name: Font of Life
rune.gathering-storm.desc: Every 2 min of the run, grants increasing adaptive AD.
rune.gathering-storm.name: Gathering Storm
rune.glacial-augment.desc: Your first attack on a target slows it by 30% for 2s.
rune.glacial-augment.name: Glacial Augment
rune.grasp-of-the-undying.desc: Every 4s in combat, your next attack deals +3.5% of your max Health as damage, heals 1.3% and grants +5 permanent Health for the run.
rune.grasp-of-the-undying.name: Grasp of the Undying
rune.grisly-mementos.desc: Killing an elite or epic monster grants +2 AD for the rest of the run (max +20).
rune.grisly-mementos.name: Grisly Mementos
rune.guardian.desc: Below 30% Health, gain a shield of 50 + 10% bonus Health for 2s. 70s cooldown.
rune.guardian.name: Guardian
rune.hail-of-blades.desc: Your first 3 attacks after 4s without attacking gain +110% Attack Speed.
rune.hail-of-blades.name: Hail of Blades
rune.hextech-flashtraption.desc: Enables Flash on the D key: blink 400 units toward the cursor. 120s cooldown.
rune.hextech-flashtraption.name: Hextech Flashtraption
rune.jack-of-all-trades.desc: +1 Ability Haste per distinct stat on your items. With 5 stats, +10 AD; with 10, +25.
rune.jack-of-all-trades.name: Jack Of All Trades
rune.last-stand.desc: +5% to +11% damage while at 60% to 30% Health.
rune.last-stand.name: Last Stand
rune.legend-alacrity.desc: +3% Attack Speed per 500 kills this run (max +15%).
rune.legend-alacrity.name: Legend: Alacrity
rune.legend-bloodline.name: Legend: Bloodline
rune.legend-haste.name: Legend: Haste
rune.lethal-tempo.desc: Attacking grants +6% Attack Speed for 6s (stacks 6x). At 6 stacks, +30% attack range.
rune.lethal-tempo.name: Lethal Tempo
rune.magical-footwear.desc: At 6 min, permanent +10% Move Speed; every 300 kills brings the bonus 30s earlier.
rune.magical-footwear.name: Magical Footwear
rune.manaflow-band.desc: Hitting an ability grants +25 max Mana (max 250). At max, restores 1% missing Mana every 5s.
rune.manaflow-band.name: Manaflow Band
rune.nimbus-cloak.desc: Using R grants +25% Move Speed for 2.5s.
rune.nimbus-cloak.name: Nimbus Cloak
rune.overgrowth.desc: +3 max Health every 100 kills; from 1,200 kills on, +3.5% max Health.
rune.overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
rune.phase-rush.desc: 3 separate hits within 4s grant +30% Move Speed for 3s. 12s cooldown.
rune.phase-rush.name: Stormraider's Surge
rune.presence-of-mind.name: Presence of Mind
rune.press-the-attack.desc: 3 consecutive attacks on the same target deal bonus adaptive damage; the target takes +8% damage for 6s.
rune.press-the-attack.name: Press the Attack
rune.relentless-hunter.name: Relentless Hunter
rune.revitalize.desc: +5% healing and shields received (+10% below 40% Health).
rune.revitalize.name: Revitalize
rune.scorch.desc: Your next ability hit burns the target, dealing bonus magic damage over 1s. 10s cooldown.
rune.scorch.name: Scorch
rune.second-wind.desc: When taking damage, regenerate 4 + 3% of missing Health over 10s.
rune.second-wind.name: Second Wind
rune.shield-bash.desc: Gaining a shield makes your next attack deal bonus damage.
rune.shield-bash.name: Shield Bash
rune.sixth-sense.desc: When a horde spawns, gain a Shield equal to 10% max Health for 3s.
rune.sixth-sense.name: Sixth Sense
rune.sudden-impact.desc: For 4s after using E, deal +7% damage.
rune.sudden-impact.name: Sudden Impact
rune.summon-aery.desc: Hits send Aery to deal bonus adaptive damage to the target. 2s cooldown.
rune.summon-aery.name: Summon Aery
rune.taste-of-blood.desc: Damaging an elite or epic monster heals 16 + 5% AD. 20s cooldown.
rune.taste-of-blood.name: Taste of Blood
rune.time-warp-tonic.name: Time Warp Tonic
rune.transcendence.desc: +5 Ability Haste at levels 5 and 8. From level 11, kills reduce your abilities' remaining cooldowns by 20%.
rune.transcendence.name: Transcendence
rune.treasure-hunter.desc: Each elite or epic kill grants +1 rune point at the end of the run (max +5).
rune.treasure-hunter.name: Treasure Hunter
rune.triple-tonic.desc: At levels 3, 6 and 9, choose a free potion.
rune.triple-tonic.name: Triple Tonic
rune.triple-tonic.title: Triple Tonic — free potion
rune.triumph.desc: Killing an elite or epic monster heals 10% of missing Health.
rune.triumph.name: Triumph
rune.ultimate-hunter.desc: +2 Ability Haste on R per 500 kills (max +15).
rune.ultimate-hunter.name: Ultimate Hunter
rune.unflinching.name: Unflinching
rune.unsealed-spellbook.desc: Every 2 min, choose the run's bonus stat: AD, Attack Speed or Ability Haste.
rune.unsealed-spellbook.name: Unsealed Spellbook
rune.unsealed-spellbook.title: Unsealed Spellbook — choose a stat
rune.waterwalking.desc: In the river: +10% Move Speed and adaptive AD.
rune.waterwalking.name: Waterwalking

static.help:
Right click on the ground: move (hold to follow) · Arrows: move
Right click on an enemy: focus target · T: auto attack
Manual attack (auto off): left click on an enemy
Level up: 1–9 pick the option
Q W E R: abilities toward the cursor
Esc: pause and sound
champion.brand.name: Brand
champion.brand.title: the Burning Vengeance
champion.brand.Q.desc: Launches a fireball that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit. An Ablaze target is stunned for 1.5s.
champion.brand.W.desc: After 0.6s, a pillar of flame erupts at the target area, dealing magic damage to enemies within 260 units. Ablaze enemies take 25% more damage.
champion.brand.E.desc: Blasts the target enemy for magic damage and spreads to enemies within 300 units of it for the same damage. The spread doubles to 600 units if the target is Ablaze.
champion.brand.R.desc: Launches a fireball that bounces between nearby enemies up to 4 times, dealing magic damage on each hit. Ablaze enemies are slowed by 30–60% for 0.25s.
